svg.text: How many eggs does a middle-class car cost?
Price of a compact family sedan (Toyota Corolla class) ÷ farm-gate price of one hen egg (60 g) · shared log scale
Data: researched 2025 list prices (models and sources in the spreadsheet's About sheet); US BLS CPI new vehicles; Eurostat HICP new motor cars; World Bank CPI; FAOSTAT Producer Prices
The dot is the anchor year; dashed years are chained back with a new-car price index (US, EU, Norway, UK) or the general CPI elsewhere. Russia: Lada Vesta; India: Maruti Dzire; Iran: Saipa
